content:
找一片櫻花林，建一個小木屋，在壁爐邊喝茶，在下雪天夜釣……

Find a cherry blossom grove. Build a small wooden house. Drink a cup of tea by a stove. Go fishing at a snowy night…

 

你將去的生物群系、長沼藍調、悠然一派等模組添加了百餘種美麗的生物群系，更有全新的自然結構等待探索！登上山巔，看萬山紅遍，層林盡染。漫步湖邊，遠眺一望無際的薰衣草花田。棹一葉孤舟，徘徊於盤根錯節的長沼中，尋找綠頭鴨和他的好朋友板魚。是誰住在深海的大鳳梨裡？找到水母田，和派大星一起抓水母吧！

Oh The Biomes You'll Go, Bayou Blues, Atmospheric and other mods add more than a hundred beautiful biomes and brand new natural structures waiting to be explored! Step onto the mountaintop, watching the fiery-red mountains. Wander by the lake, looking far into the lavender field stretching to the horizon. Row a lonely boat, hovering in the bayou with twisted roots, looking for the mallard and his slabfish friend. Who lives in the pineapple under the sea? Find the jellyfish field and go jellyfishing with Patrick Star!

 

各種樂事等美食模組為整合包帶來了數百種美食。那不勒斯風味、農夫暇事等帶來了眾多奶昔茶飲。自訂三明治和湯飲鋪更是可以打破固定合成配方的限制，創造獨屬於你的特色食物。

Various “Delight mods” add hundreds of delicious food to the modpack. Neapolitan, Farmer's Respite and other mods add numerous milk shake and tea drinks. With the help of Culinary Construct and Thermopolium, you can break the limit of fixed recipes and create your peculiar cuisine.

 

除了豐富多彩的主世界，落英還添加了野趣十足的平行世界。神秘原始的暮色森林，寧靜祥和的永晝之地和恆曉之地，危險與機遇並存！

Besides the colorful overworld, Fallen Petals also adds new wild dimensions. In the mysterious and primitive Twilight Forest, in the quiet and peaceful Everbright & Everdawn, danger and fortune coexist!  

 

落英同樣添加了許多有趣的小玩意。喜歡養魚嗎？去小溪邊抓兩條野生金魚，培養全新品種全新花色的金魚！如果家裡放不下占地幾米的大魚缸，為什麼不試試玻璃罐中養魚呢？看慣了原版的火把和燈籠，那就來看看河豚燈籠和史萊姆燈籠吧，或者栓一根繩子掛上喜慶的大紅燈籠，也可以放飛孔明燈，但是好像更加孤獨了……你甚至可以——把火把插到半磚和天花板上？？如果原版的皮膚過於單調，那麼3d立體皮膚，再戴上各式各樣的帽子會不會更加有趣？背包格子不夠用怎麼辦？那就把鞘翅背在背上，把箭袋挎在腰間，把不死圖騰當做項鍊掛起來。如果你找不到心儀的生物群系，那麼自然羅盤會為你指明方向。在灌木叢中你可以聽到蟲子窸窸窣窣，在洞穴中你可以聽到鐘乳石滴水的空洞回聲……

Fallen Petals also adds many interesting stuffs. Do you like keeping fish? Go to Heathe river and catch two wild goldfish and cultivate new species with unique figures! If there isn’t enough space for a huge aquarium, why not try to keep fish in a glass jar? If you are tired of vanilla torches and lanterns, have a look at pufferfish lanterns and slime lanterns, or pull a rope and hang red lanterns on it, or let fly a sky lantern, although it seems to be lonelier… You can even – put a torch onto the slab or the ceiling?? If vanilla skin is too boring, will 3D skin with fancy hats be better? What should I do if there aren’t enough slots? You can place the elytra on your back slot, put the quiver on your belt slot and wear the totem of undying as a necklace. If it’s hard to find your favored biome, nature's compass will indicate the directions for you. In the bushes you can hear insects singing, in the caves you can hear hollow echo of dripping…

 

由於optfine鬼畜的相容能力，落英整合包採用oculus來加載光影。包內也有很多輔助優化模組，可以提升遊戲體驗。新版落英（v1.3開始）會自動加載資源包和數據包。

Due to the terrible compatibility of Optfine, Fallen Petals uses Oculus to load shaders. There are many utility and optimizing mods which can improve your game experience. Fallen Petals (v1.3 or later) will automatically load internal resource packs.

因為cf協議的原因，孔明燈模組不允許上傳，大家可以自行下載添加↓
The Sky Lantern mod is not available on cf, it is recommended to install by your own ↓
